newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 11.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
The Reserve Bank of Australia made a surprise 50 basis point cut in the official cash rate early on Wednesday.

French pay TV channel Canal Plus said on Tuesday it had entered a long-term agreement with News Corp unit 20th Century Fox allowing it to have rights for all Fox films for encrypted broadcasts. The "strategic alliance" also involves the development of channels to be carried on each company's networks around the world, Canal Plus said in a statement.

Australis Media Ltd chairman Mark Johnson said on Wednesday the pay tv operator was expecting a distinctly better year this year than last. Australis reported a net loss of A$51.1 million for the first quarter to September 30 after a net loss of A$251.69 million in the year to June 1996.
Minotaur Gold NL said on Tuesday that a drilling program at the Birthday Prospect in South Australia's highly prospective Gawler Craton exploration area had outlined four significant gold anomalies.
